subject: Handoff: Jupiter Therapeutics — Activation & Networking Roadmap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@jupiter-thera.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff: Jupiter Therapeutics — Activation & Networking Roadmap

Team — looping you in to transfer ownership of Jupiter Therapeutics (Deal JD-8891). High-level context below and key asks to kick the activation off next week.

Why they chose Redwood
- Need consistent low-latency inference for real-time triage in their clinician workflow.
- Required private deployment (VPC) and committed reserved capacity.

Contract & timeline
- Signed SOW v1.3 attached (DocuSign link included). Target go-live: 2028-07-22 (4 weeks from kickoff).
- Procurement still routing a standard security addendum; we have 2-week window for network and compliance tasks.

Technical constraints & critical path items
1) Networking: customer requires VPC peering + allowlisted IPs for 3 regional clusters — see attached diagram.
2) Data ingress: initial dataset will be S3 -> Redwood Ingest API. They want zero-persistence option for PHI; we need to confirm KMS/HSM workflow.
3) Model variant: they'll start on a Redwood-verified Llama-3 34B quantized profile (latency target 120ms p50), with fallback to a 13B for spike mitigation.
4) Rollout plan: canary 7 days behind prod traffic with automatic fallback and token-level cost alerts configured.

Immediate asks (owners in parentheses)
- Kickoff meeting invite and agenda (Tessa) — propose Wed 2028-06-21 10am PT.
- Network questions and IP allowlist doc (Vivek) — share CIDR ranges + peering checklist.
- Confirm SOW redlines and signature (Ben) — procurement contact copied.
- Pre-kickoff doc for CS (Marissa) — activation checklist + success criteria.

Attachments: Jupiter_SOW_v1.3.pdf, networking-diagram-jupiter.png, activation-checklist-v0.9.xlsx

Thanks — I will remain available during the first 2 weeks of the engagement for exec-level context.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@jupiter-thera.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@jupiter-thera.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: Jupiter Therapeutics — Activation & Networking Roadmap

Marissa — thanks for the context. I can own the kickoff and primary activation path. Confirming availability for Wed 6/21 10am PT (calendar invite sent).

Pre-kickoff checklist I will cover:
- Roles & escalation matrix (CS lead, deployment engineer, customer PM)
- Acceptance criteria for go-live (throughput, latency, error rates)
- Required test data and access (staging S3, sample prompts)
- Compliance handoffs (SOC2 evidence request, KMS integration)

Vivek — can you share the peering checklist + required public IP block we advertise? I want to attach that to the kickoff notes so the customer's network team has specifics.

Ben — please confirm procurement timeline and whether we can get the SA signed before the kickoff; if not, we should flag any tasks that must wait on procurement.

I added a short acceptance matrix to the activation checklist (see attachment).

—
Tessa Morgan
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2028 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: Jupiter Therapeutics — Activation & Networking Roadmap

Tessa/Marissa — attaching the CIDR ranges and peering checklist now (networking-diagram-jupiter.png). Key notes:
- We'll provision 3 regional endpoints (us-west-2, us-east-1, us-west-1) behind our NATs; customer must create routes for the advertised /28 block.
- For the zero-persistence PHI requirement: need KMS key exchange and an HSM-backed envelope key. CS/config must request a dedicated KMS alias in the onboarding form.
- Firewall rules: allow outbound 443 to our egress IPs and inbound only for peered private ips.

I'll join the kickoff to walk through the diagram.

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement <procurement@jupiter-thera.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: Jupiter Therapeutics — Activation & Networking Roadmap

Marissa/Tessa — looped in procurement. Quick status: Jupiter's procurement says they have a PO route but need our standard SOC2 CT scan + last 12 months uptime SLA and an export of our incident response playbook. I've attached the signed SOW (v1.3) and sent the DocuSign envelope — expect signature by EOD 6/22.

If procurement delays past 6/23, call out any config work that can proceed: VPC peering prep + staging account provisioning can happen before signature if we get a mutual NDA addendum in place.

—
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@jupiter-thera.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@jupiter-thera.com>, Procurement <procurement@jupiter-thera.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jun 2028 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: Jupiter Therapeutics — Activation & Networking Roadmap

Thanks, team — appreciate the clear handoff. Confirming kickoff Wed 6/21 10am PT worked well for our engineers; Samir and I reviewed the network diagram and will share our line-of-business PO by 6/22 EOD. Two quick clarifications: 

1) Can Redwood support a canary window of 7 days with traffic split 10/90? We want to validate latency and safety before full cutover.
2) For the zero-persistence mode, can you confirm whether logs are retained for 30 days for troubleshooting and then purged? We need to align with our compliance counsel.

We'll send the procurement contact a single consolidated question list after the kickoff. Looking forward to working with Tessa.

Best,
Elena Torres
Dir. of Clinical Operations, Jupiter Therapeutics
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@jupiter-thera.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@jupiter-thera.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: Jupiter Therapeutics — Activation & Networking Roadmap

Follow-up notes from kickoff and next steps (owner in parentheses):
- Confirm DocuSign completion + PO (Ben) — target 6/22 EOD.
- Security addendum Qs: We will provide SOC2 scan, IR playbook excerpt, and confirm log retention policy. (Ben/Tessa)
- Canary plan: 7 days @ 10/90 traffic split; will instrument latency SLOs and automated rollback. (Tessa/Vivek)
- KMS/HSM: Vivek to send KMS alias workflow and required customer actions. (Vivek)
- Staging: CS to provision staging project and upload sample prompts. (Tessa)

I'll open a shared Drive folder for onboarding artifacts and post the activation-checklist-v0.9.xlsx. If procurement holds signatures past 6/23 we will proceed with non-destructive staging work and keep configuration gated behind signed SOW.

Thanks team — I am the CS lead for this engagement and will DM the group with calendar invites for the 7-day canary monitoring cadence.

—
Tessa Morgan
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
